title: Neighbor notable coordinates
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a long code table, let $\\varepsilon\\in\\mathbb R$, and let $v$ be a vertex of $G$. The neighbor notable coordinates at $v$ are the coordinates $i\\in\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$ for which $\\varepsilon$ is strictly less than the stable influence, at noise parameter $1-\\varepsilon$, of coordinate $i$ in the averaged neighbor function of $T$ at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
